git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(test): close capture-helper pipes on every exit path, not just success (PR #509 review finding H1)

pre_compact_test.go's capturePreCompactOutput closed its write end
only after require.NoError(HandlePreCompact(...)) succeeded, so a
failed assertion left the drain goroutine blocked on ReadFrom forever
-- the exact regression the prior round's move off t.Cleanup traded
for. Extract the pipe/drain/close orchestration into a shared
captureStdout helper that closes unconditionally (defer + sync.Once
safety net for panics, explicit close on the normal path for prompt
release) before asserting fn's error, and rewire all four capture
helpers in the package (pre_compact, session_start, subagent_start's
two variants) onto it. runHookForVerifier and the
NoMissionStoreIsLegacy inline block were already safe -- they never
asserted the hook's error before cleanup -- but were migrated too so
there is exactly one implementation of this pattern to audit.

Falsified pre-fix: gating captureStdout's close on fnErr == nil (the
shape the buggy helper had) hangs TestCaptureStdout_DrainGoroutineExitsOnFnError
indefinitely under `timeout 20`; with the unconditional close it
passes in <1s.
EOF
)"
